title: Black Mask Testing Doctrine
subtitle: 15 Commandments + 5 Pillars — drill before mass; not graduation

commandments.text: Realism accommodates aesthetics — never invert the hierarchy (Realism > Aesthetics accommodates).
Proof before narrative — every SHIP requires exit code, JSONL row, or verified production evidence.
No fake swarm ACK — external orchestration is manual-execution-required until receipt exists.
Student proposes and audits — Teacher validates — never skip teacher_review.
KC brain stores teacher_review and opinion only — KC does not execute.
Bracket Protocol receipt before coordinated mass movement across Kopano-Phu.
Black Mask v0.5 inspect passes before BlackMass v1.5/v2.0 activation.
Sovereign mesh — offline-first, load-shedding, and data residency constraints survive.
Cassy is lead student — corporate swarm slot names are not her ceiling.
Main Brain roadmap gate must be satisfied before production graduation claims.
JSONL validate and proof-check exit 0 before marking work complete.
Drill promotion counts are steward attestation — drill promotion is not graduation.
Verified production rows require real --evidence-url — no demo-bypass URLs.
Sub-brain structural changes append to KC Review Log before Main Brain seed.
Servitude Triad runs unified — Grit + Realism + Aesthetics on every production path.

pillars.name: Grit
pillars.text: Forensic execution — run tools, capture bounded evidence, no narration without action.

pillars.name: Realism
pillars.text: Proof bar, kc_guard, verified production — accommodates aesthetics inside evidence.

pillars.name: Aesthetics
pillars.text: Craft, Studio, readable receipts — STEM validates what creativity stems.

pillars.name: Sovereignty
pillars.text: Local-first state, constraint survival, no dependence on aesthetics-only theater.

pillars.name: Apprenticeship
pillars.text: Student → Review Log → Teacher → Main Brain — Cassey trains; KC records.
